title.zh: ZachXBT: EU entity suspected of losing over $106M in crypto theft
title.en: ZachXBT: EU entity suspected of losing over $106M in crypto theft

current_state.zh: On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that an unidentified EU-based entity appears to have lost more than $106 million from multiple centralized exchange accounts, with the suspected attacker converting stablecoins to ETH, swapping into privacy coin XMR, and bridging funds across chains to obscure the trail.
